headline: The plan and the architecture disagree on where uploads go
ask: Should impl-uploads follow the architecture or the plan?

options.title: Follow the architecture
options.text: Uploads go through the volume service; the plan's bucket is dropped.

options.title: Follow the plan
options.text: Uploads go to the S3 bucket; the architecture gains an exception.

why: The architecture is the newer decision.
default: impl-uploads waits, and Upload storage slips past today.
